scope: overtaking (passing another vehicle, and being passed)

vocabulary.definition: A person driving a motor vehicle on a road.
To overtake, that is to move past, the vehicle ahead.
An area around a vehicle that its driver's rearview mirrors cannot show.
A stretch of road marked by a solid yellow line on the driver's side of the road, or by signs prohibiting passing.
The center lane of a street, used only by vehicles turning left.
A highway where vehicles can enter and exit only at interchanges.

rules.title: Keep right except when passing
rules.when: driving on a road
rules.action: keep to the right side of the road
rules.unless: the DRIVER is making a PASS on a two- or three-lane street OR is driving on a one-way street OR the right side of the road is blocked
rules.statement: WHEN driving on a road, the DRIVER MUST keep to the right side of the road, UNLESS the DRIVER is making a PASS on a two- or three-lane street OR is driving on a one-way street OR the right side of the road is blocked.

rules.title: Wait for the right time
rules.when: the DRIVER wants to PASS another vehicle
rules.action: be patient and wait until the time is right to PASS
rules.statement: WHEN the DRIVER wants to PASS another vehicle, the DRIVER SHOULD be patient and wait until the time is right to PASS.

vague_terms.explanation: no conditions given for when passing is safe

rules.note: The handbook warns that improper passing often results in deadly head-on crashes.

rules.title: Make certain the way is clear
rules.when: about to PASS
rules.action: make certain the way is clear
rules.statement: WHEN about to PASS, the PASSER MUST make certain the way is clear.

vague_terms.explanation: no gap or sight distance given

rules.title: Signal before changing lanes to pass
rules.when: changing lanes to PASS
rules.action: give the proper signal before changing lanes
rules.statement: WHEN changing lanes to PASS, the PASSER MUST give the proper signal before changing lanes.

rules.title: Tap horn to alert driver ahead
rules.when: making a PASS AND it is necessary to avoid surprising the driver ahead
rules.action: tap the horn
rules.statement: WHEN making a PASS AND it is necessary to avoid surprising the driver ahead, the PASSER MUST tap the horn.

vague_terms.term: it is necessary to avoid surprising the driver ahead
vague_terms.explanation: no criteria for when a horn tap is needed

rules.note: Stated in both the basic passing rules and the two-lane passing procedure.

rules.title: Do not cut in too quickly
rules.when: returning to the original lane after a PASS
rules.action: cut in too quickly
rules.statement: WHEN returning to the original lane after a PASS, the PASSER SHOULD NOT cut in too quickly.

vague_terms.explanation: no distance or time gap given

rules.title: Do not linger in a blind spot
rules.when: making a PASS
rules.action: drive or linger in the other driver's BLIND SPOT, but either complete the PASS or slow down so as not to be in it
rules.statement: WHEN making a PASS, the PASSER MUST NOT drive or linger in the other driver's BLIND SPOT, but either complete the PASS or slow down so as not to be in it.
rules.note: Highway safety tips (10.48) give the same instruction: stay behind or go around the other vehicle and do not follow to the side.

rules.title: Use middle or left lane to pass on highway
rules.when: driving on a multi-lane highway AND traveling faster than other traffic OR passing other vehicles
rules.action: use the middle or left lane
rules.statement: WHEN driving on a multi-lane highway AND traveling faster than other traffic OR passing other vehicles, the DRIVER MUST use the middle or left lane.

rules.title: Farthest left lane is for passing
rules.when: on a roadway with more than one lane for traffic in the same direction where the left-lane sign is posted AND the DRIVER is traveling slower than other traffic
rules.action: travel in a lane other than the farthest left lane, which is for passing only
rules.statement: WHEN on a roadway with more than one lane for traffic in the same direction where the left-lane sign is posted AND the DRIVER is traveling slower than other traffic, the DRIVER SHOULD travel in a lane other than the farthest left lane, which is for passing only.
rules.note: From the description of a sign whose image is missing. The sign is in the regulatory and warning sign table, but it is worded with 'should'.

rules.title: No driving on left in a no-passing zone
rules.when: in a NO-PASSING ZONE OR where pavement markings, solid lane lines or signs prohibit driving on the left
rules.action: drive on the left side of the road
rules.statement: WHEN in a NO-PASSING ZONE OR where pavement markings, solid lane lines or signs prohibit driving on the left, the DRIVER MUST NOT drive on the left side of the road.

rules.title: No driving on left on roads with two or more lanes each way
rules.when: there are two or more traffic lanes in each direction
rules.action: drive on the left side of the road
rules.statement: WHEN there are two or more traffic lanes in each direction, the DRIVER MUST NOT drive on the left side of the road.

rules.title: No driving on left near intersections and railroad crossings
rules.when: within 100 feet of or crossing an intersection or railroad crossing
rules.action: drive on the left side of the road
rules.statement: WHEN within 100 feet of or crossing an intersection or railroad crossing, the DRIVER MUST NOT drive on the left side of the road.

rules.title: No driving on left where vision is limited
rules.when: on a hill, curve, or any other place where vision is limited
rules.action: drive on the left side of the road
rules.statement: WHEN on a hill, curve, or any other place where vision is limited, the DRIVER MUST NOT drive on the left side of the road.

rules.title: No driving on left near bridges, viaducts, tunnels
rules.when: within 100 feet of a bridge, viaduct, or tunnel
rules.action: drive on the left side of the road
rules.statement: WHEN within 100 feet of a bridge, viaduct, or tunnel, the DRIVER MUST NOT drive on the left side of the road.

rules.title: Broken yellow center line may be crossed to pass
rules.when: on a two-lane road with two-way traffic and a broken yellow center line AND the DRIVER is passing another vehicle OR the right half of the road is closed
rules.action: cross the broken line
rules.statement: WHEN on a two-lane road with two-way traffic and a broken yellow center line AND the DRIVER is passing another vehicle OR the right half of the road is closed, the DRIVER MAY cross the broken line, UNLESS it is not safe.

rules.title: Do not cross solid yellow center line
rules.when: on a two-lane road with two-way traffic AND the yellow center line is solid OR crossing it is not safe
rules.action: cross the center line
rules.statement: WHEN on a two-lane road with two-way traffic AND the yellow center line is solid OR crossing it is not safe, the DRIVER MUST NOT cross the center line.
rules.note: The same block tells drivers to keep to the right of the yellow center line.

rules.title: Do not cross double yellow line to pass
rules.when: on a multi-lane highway with four or more lanes divided by a double yellow line
rules.action: cross the double yellow line to PASS
rules.statement: WHEN on a multi-lane highway with four or more lanes divided by a double yellow line, the PASSER MUST NOT cross the double yellow line to PASS.

rules.title: Broken or dashed lines permit passing
rules.when: the lane line is broken or dashed AND it is safe
rules.action: PASS or change lanes
rules.statement: WHEN the lane line is broken or dashed AND it is safe, the DRIVER MAY PASS or change lanes.

rules.title: Do Not Cross Yellow Lines sign
rules.when: a Do Not Cross Yellow Lines sign is posted
rules.action: PASS another vehicle
rules.statement: WHEN a Do Not Cross Yellow Lines sign is posted, the DRIVER MUST NOT PASS another vehicle.
rules.note: Regulatory sign; its image is missing. The handbook gives the reason: the distance the driver can see ahead is too limited for passing to be safe.

rules.title: Do Not Pass sign
rules.when: a Do Not Pass sign is posted
rules.action: PASS other vehicles
rules.statement: WHEN a Do Not Pass sign is posted, the DRIVER MUST NOT PASS other vehicles.
rules.note: Regulatory sign; its image is missing.

rules.title: Curve and winding road warning signs: do not pass
rules.when: a warning sign shows that the road ahead curves, turns sharply, makes a double or reverse curve, or winds
rules.action: slow down, keep right, and not PASS
rules.statement: WHEN a warning sign shows that the road ahead curves, turns sharply, makes a double or reverse curve, or winds, the DRIVER MUST slow down, keep right, and not PASS.
rules.penalty: Fine of $1 to $200, doubled in a work zone when workers are present.
rules.note: The sign descriptions use plain commands ('do not pass'). Recorded as REQUIREMENT because 6.266 makes disobeying a warning sign a violation with a stated fine. The sign images are missing; the winding-road sign says 'drive slowly and carefully, and do not pass'.

rules.title: Center turn lane not for passing
rules.when: a road has a SHARED LEFT-TURN LANE
rules.action: use the SHARED LEFT-TURN LANE for passing or as a through-traffic lane
rules.statement: WHEN a road has a SHARED LEFT-TURN LANE, the DRIVER SHOULD NOT use the SHARED LEFT-TURN LANE for passing or as a through-traffic lane.
rules.note: Stated twice, in a sign description and in a special note, both times worded 'should never'.

rules.title: Keep distance to see ahead
rules.when: preparing to PASS on a two-lane road
rules.action: keep enough distance from the car in front to see ahead clearly
rules.statement: WHEN preparing to PASS on a two-lane road, the PASSER MUST keep enough distance from the car in front to see ahead clearly.

rules.title: Check mirrors and blind spot
rules.when: preparing to PASS on a two-lane road
rules.action: check the rearview mirror and side mirrors and look over the shoulder into the BLIND SPOT to make sure the roadway is clear and no other vehicles are passing
rules.statement: WHEN preparing to PASS on a two-lane road, the PASSER MUST check the rearview mirror and side mirrors and look over the shoulder into the BLIND SPOT to make sure the roadway is clear and no other vehicles are passing.

rules.title: Left turn signal before passing
rules.when: preparing to PASS on a two-lane road
rules.action: turn on the left turn signal to alert drivers behind
rules.statement: WHEN preparing to PASS on a two-lane road, the PASSER MUST turn on the left turn signal to alert drivers behind.

rules.title: Check ahead for no-passing zones and oncoming traffic
rules.when: preparing to PASS on a two-lane road
rules.action: check well ahead for signs and pavement markings for NO-PASSING ZONEs and check for oncoming traffic in the left lane
rules.statement: WHEN preparing to PASS on a two-lane road, the PASSER MUST check well ahead for signs and pavement markings for NO-PASSING ZONEs and check for oncoming traffic in the left lane.

rules.title: Enough time and space before oncoming car is within 200 feet
rules.when: preparing to PASS on a two-lane road
rules.action: be sure there is enough time and space to overtake the car ahead and return to the right lane before an approaching car comes within 200 feet
rules.statement: WHEN preparing to PASS on a two-lane road, the PASSER MUST be sure there is enough time and space to overtake the car ahead and return to the right lane before an approaching car comes within 200 feet.

rules.title: Pass on the left
rules.when: making a PASS on a two-lane road
rules.action: PASS on the left
rules.statement: WHEN making a PASS on a two-lane road, the PASSER MUST PASS on the left.

rules.title: Return only after clearing overtaken vehicle
rules.when: making a PASS on a two-lane road
rules.action: return to the right lane
rules.unless: the PASSER has safely cleared the overtaken vehicle AND can see it in the rearview mirror
rules.statement: WHEN making a PASS on a two-lane road, the PASSER MUST NOT return to the right lane, UNLESS the PASSER has safely cleared the overtaken vehicle AND can see it in the rearview mirror.

rules.title: Signal right, return, cancel signal
rules.when: returning to the right lane after a PASS on a two-lane road
rules.action: turn on the right turn signal, return to the right lane, and turn the signal off after completing the lane change
rules.statement: WHEN returning to the right lane after a PASS on a two-lane road, the PASSER MUST turn on the right turn signal, return to the right lane, and turn the signal off after completing the lane change.

rules.title: When passing on the right is allowed
rules.when: conditions permit it safely AND the road is clear of parked vehicles or other lane obstructions and wide enough for two or more lanes in each direction OR the DRIVER is on a one-way road
rules.action: PASS on the right
rules.statement: WHEN conditions permit it safely AND the road is clear of parked vehicles or other lane obstructions and wide enough for two or more lanes in each direction OR the DRIVER is on a one-way road, the DRIVER MAY ONLY PASS on the right.
rules.note: MAY ONLY: passing on the right is allowed under these conditions and not otherwise. The paved-shoulder case is PASS-SIDE-02.

rules.title: Passing on a paved shoulder
rules.when: the vehicle being passed is slowing or stopped on the main traveled portion of the highway OR is disabled OR is preparing to make a left turn
rules.action: PASS on a paved shoulder
rules.statement: WHEN the vehicle being passed is slowing or stopped on the main traveled portion of the highway OR is disabled OR is preparing to make a left turn, the DRIVER MAY ONLY PASS on a paved shoulder.
rules.note: MAY ONLY: passing on a paved shoulder is allowed in these cases and not otherwise.

rules.title: Do not pass on the right off the pavement
rules.when: passing on the right
rules.action: drive off the paved portion of the highway
rules.statement: WHEN passing on the right, the DRIVER MUST NOT drive off the paved portion of the highway.

rules.title: Do not speed up when being passed
rules.when: another vehicle is passing the DRIVER
rules.action: increase speed
rules.statement: WHEN another vehicle is passing the DRIVER, the DRIVER MUST NOT increase speed.
rules.note: Repeated for trucks: 'Don't speed up while the truck is passing.'

rules.title: Stay in lane when being passed
rules.when: another vehicle is passing the DRIVER
rules.action: stay in the DRIVER's lane
rules.statement: WHEN another vehicle is passing the DRIVER, the DRIVER MUST stay in the DRIVER's lane.

rules.title: Move right on unmarked lanes
rules.when: being passed on the left AND the lanes are not marked
rules.action: safely move as far to the right as possible
rules.statement: WHEN being passed on the left AND the lanes are not marked, the DRIVER MUST safely move as far to the right as possible.

rules.title: Make passing safe and easy
rules.when: another vehicle is passing the DRIVER
rules.action: make it as safe and easy as possible for the other driver to PASS
rules.statement: WHEN another vehicle is passing the DRIVER, the DRIVER MUST make it as safe and easy as possible for the other driver to PASS.

vague_terms.term: as safe and easy as possible

rules.title: Do not block someone from passing
rules.when: another driver is trying to PASS or enter the DRIVER's lane
rules.action: intentionally slow down, slam on the brakes, or speed up to keep the other driver from passing or entering the lane
rules.statement: WHEN another driver is trying to PASS or enter the DRIVER's lane, the DRIVER MUST NOT intentionally slow down, slam on the brakes, or speed up to keep the other driver from passing or entering the lane.
rules.note: From the road rage tips.

rules.title: Be ready to let faster traffic pass
rules.when: on a highway in any lane except the right lane used for slower traffic
rules.action: be prepared to move to another lane to allow faster traffic to PASS
rules.statement: WHEN on a highway in any lane except the right lane used for slower traffic, the DRIVER SHOULD be prepared to move to another lane to allow faster traffic to PASS.

rules.title: Keep to far side of lane when truck passes
rules.when: a truck is passing the DRIVER
rules.action: keep to the far side of the DRIVER's lane
rules.statement: WHEN a truck is passing the DRIVER, the DRIVER MUST keep to the far side of the DRIVER's lane.

rules.title: Slightly reduce speed when truck passes
rules.when: a truck is passing the DRIVER
rules.action: slightly reduce speed
rules.statement: WHEN a truck is passing the DRIVER, the DRIVER SHOULD slightly reduce speed.

vague_terms.explanation: amount of speed reduction not given

rules.title: Truck driver signals before returning
rules.when: returning to the lane of the vehicle the truck has just passed
rules.action: signal to let the other driver know the truck is returning to that lane
rules.statement: WHEN returning to the lane of the vehicle the truck has just passed, the DRIVER of a truck SHOULD signal to let the other driver know the truck is returning to that lane.

rules.title: Truck driver eases pass by staying to far side
rules.when: another vehicle is passing the truck
rules.action: stay to the far side of the lane to make passing easier
rules.statement: WHEN another vehicle is passing the truck, the DRIVER of a truck SHOULD stay to the far side of the lane to make passing easier.

rules.title: Checks before passing a truck
rules.when: passing a truck
rules.action: first check to the front and rear and check mirrors and BLIND SPOTs, then move into the passing lane only if it is clear and the PASSER is in a legal passing zone
rules.statement: WHEN passing a truck, the PASSER MUST first check to the front and rear and check mirrors and BLIND SPOTs, then move into the passing lane only if it is clear and the PASSER is in a legal passing zone.

rules.title: Flash headlights when passing a truck
rules.when: passing a truck
rules.action: let the truck driver know of the PASS by flashing the headlights, especially at night
rules.statement: WHEN passing a truck, the PASSER MUST let the truck driver know of the PASS by flashing the headlights, especially at night.

rules.title: Complete a pass quickly
rules.when: passing a truck or other vehicle
rules.action: complete the PASS as quickly as possible and not stay alongside the other vehicle
rules.statement: WHEN passing a truck or other vehicle, the PASSER MUST complete the PASS as quickly as possible and not stay alongside the other vehicle.
rules.note: The same block says passing a truck on level road takes 3 to 5 seconds longer than passing a car, and that on a downgrade the PASSER may need to increase speed.

rules.title: Return in front of truck only when its front is visible
rules.when: returning in front of a truck after passing it
rules.action: move back in front of the truck
rules.unless: the PASSER can see the entire front of the truck in the rearview mirror
rules.statement: WHEN returning in front of a truck after passing it, the PASSER MUST NOT move back in front of the truck, UNLESS the PASSER can see the entire front of the truck in the rearview mirror.
rules.note: If the truck driver flashes the truck's lights after the pass, that signals it is clear to pull back in front of the truck.

rules.title: Maintain speed after passing a truck
rules.when: the PASSER has passed a truck
rules.action: maintain speed
rules.statement: WHEN the PASSER has passed a truck, the PASSER MUST maintain speed.

rules.title: Do not pass a truck on the right if it may turn right
rules.when: there is a possibility a truck might make a right turn
rules.action: PASS the truck on the right
rules.statement: WHEN there is a possibility a truck might make a right turn, the DRIVER MUST NOT PASS the truck on the right.

vague_terms.explanation: no cues given for judging when a right turn is possible

rules.note: The handbook explains that trucks make wide right turns and may leave an open space to the right before the turn.

rules.title: Wait for a backing truck
rules.when: a truck is preparing to back up or is backing from a road into a loading area
rules.action: never cross behind the truck and wait for it to complete its maneuver before trying to PASS
rules.statement: WHEN a truck is preparing to back up or is backing from a road into a loading area, the DRIVER MUST never cross behind the truck and wait for it to complete its maneuver before trying to PASS.

rules.title: Never cut in front of a truck
rules.when: driving near a truck or bus, including when trying to reach an exit or turn or approaching a single-lane construction zone
rules.action: cut into the open space in front of the truck or bus, but either slow down and exit or stay behind it
rules.statement: WHEN driving near a truck or bus, including when trying to reach an exit or turn or approaching a single-lane construction zone, the DRIVER MUST NOT cut into the open space in front of the truck or bus, but either slow down and exit or stay behind it.
rules.note: The handbook calls trying to beat a truck to a single-lane construction zone particularly dangerous.

rules.title: Care when passing a distracted driver
rules.when: passing a driver who seems to be distracted
rules.action: be very careful, as the other driver may not be aware of the PASSER and may drift in front
rules.statement: WHEN passing a driver who seems to be distracted, the PASSER SHOULD be very careful, as the other driver may not be aware of the PASSER and may drift in front.

vague_terms.explanation: judgement left to the driver; 10.207 to 10.210 list cues

rules.title: Passing stopped mail, delivery and trash vehicles
rules.when: a mail, delivery, or trash-collection vehicle is stopped on the road
rules.action: proceed with caution and, if possible, change lanes before safely passing it
rules.statement: WHEN a mail, delivery, or trash-collection vehicle is stopped on the road, the DRIVER MUST proceed with caution and, if possible, change lanes before safely passing it.

vague_terms.explanation: does not say when a lane change is impossible

rules.title: Stop for school bus with flashing red lights
rules.when: approaching a school bus from either direction AND the bus is displaying alternately flashing red lights
rules.action: stop
rules.unless: the school bus is on a different road OR the DRIVER is on a CONTROLLED-ACCESS HIGHWAY where the bus is stopped in a loading zone and pedestrians are not permitted to cross
rules.statement: WHEN approaching a school bus from either direction AND the bus is displaying alternately flashing red lights, the DRIVER MUST stop, UNLESS the school bus is on a different road OR the DRIVER is on a CONTROLLED-ACCESS HIGHWAY where the bus is stopped in a loading zone and pedestrians are not permitted to cross.
rules.penalty: 1st conviction: fine of $500 to $1,250; later convictions within 5 years: $1,000 to $2,000 and possible suspension up to 6 months; Class A misdemeanor or state jail felony if serious bodily injury is caused.
rules.note: Block 5.78 refers to 'Table 17' for penalties, but the school bus penalty table is Table 15. A subsequent conviction for passing a school bus also brings mandatory license suspension (2.300).

rules.title: Do not pass a stopped school bus
rules.when: stopped for a school bus displaying alternately flashing red lights
rules.action: PASS the school bus
rules.unless: the school bus has resumed motion OR the DRIVER is signaled by the bus driver to proceed OR the red lights are no longer flashing
rules.statement: WHEN stopped for a school bus displaying alternately flashing red lights, the DRIVER MUST NOT PASS the school bus, UNLESS the school bus has resumed motion OR the DRIVER is signaled by the bus driver to proceed OR the red lights are no longer flashing.
rules.penalty: 1st conviction: fine of $500 to $1,250; later convictions within 5 years: $1,000 to $2,000 and possible suspension up to 6 months; Class A misdemeanor if serious bodily injury is caused while passing a stopped school bus; state jail felony for a repeat.
rules.note: A subsequent conviction for overtaking and passing a school bus brings mandatory license suspension (2.300).

rules.title: Cyclist may take the full lane to overtake
rules.when: the CYCLIST is overtaking and passing another vehicle proceeding in the same direction
rules.action: take the full lane instead of riding as near as possible to the right curb or edge of the road
rules.statement: WHEN the CYCLIST is overtaking and passing another vehicle proceeding in the same direction, the CYCLIST MAY take the full lane instead of riding as near as possible to the right curb or edge of the road.
rules.note: Inferred from two places: 10.180 lists overtaking as a condition allowing a cyclist to take the full lane, and 14.15 lists it as an exception to riding near the right edge.
